CustomSql.SqlQuery:
-- Select all data from the historic news table, parsing its date format
SELECT
    id,
    title,
    -- Parse the 'dd/mm/yyyy' string and cast to a DATE
    CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS date,
    description,
    country,
    category,
    symbol,
    url,
    importance,
    tag,
    tag_confidence,
    -- Transform commodity with an exception for LPG
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodity, '-', ' ')) = 'lpg' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodity, '-', ' ')) = 'rapeseed oil' THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(commodity, '-', ' ')) = 'brent crude oil' THEN 'Brent'
        ELSE ARRAY_JOIN(
            TRANSFORM(
                SPLIT(REPLACE(commodity, '-', ' '), ' '),
                word -> UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ),
            ' '
        )
    END AS commodity
FROM
    shippingbi.historic_te_news
WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date != '' -- Added filter to prevent parsing empty strings

UNION ALL

-- Select and transform data from the new history table, parsing its date format
SELECT
    -- Generate a unique ID starting from 900,000,000 to avoid collision
    CAST(900000000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS BIGINT) AS id,
    title,
    -- Use COALESCE and TRY to handle mixed date/datetime formats
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            TRY(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i:%s')), -- First, try parsing the full datetime format
            TRY(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y'))           -- If that fails, try parsing the date-only format
        )
    AS DATE) AS date,
    description,
    country,
    'Commodity' AS category,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS symbol, -- Use NULL as the symbol column does not exist in this table
    url,
    importance, 
    tag,
    confidence AS tag_confidence,
    -- Transform the original 'id' (aliased as commodity) with an exception for LPG
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'lpg' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'rapeseed oil' THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'brent crude oil' THEN 'Brent'
        ELSE ARRAY_JOIN(
            TRANSFORM(
                SPLIT(REPLACE(id, '-', ' '), ' '),
                word -> UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ),
            ' '
        )
    END AS commodity
FROM
    shippingbi.energy_news_items_history
-- Add all filtering conditions to the WHERE clause
WHERE
    id NOT IN ('BAID', 'BCTI')
    AND title IS NOT NULL
    -- Added to prevent errors from rows with no date
    AND date IS NOT NULL AND date != ''

UNION ALL

-- Select and transform data from the construction news history table
SELECT
    -- Generate a unique ID starting from 1,000,000,000 to avoid collision
    CAST(1000000000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS BIGINT) AS id,
    title,
    -- Parse the 'dd/mm/yyyy' string and cast to a DATE
    CAST(date_parse(date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS date,

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS country, -- country column does not exist in this table
    'Commodity' AS category,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS symbol, -- symbol column does not exist in this table
    url,
    importance,
    tag,
    confidence AS tag_confidence,
    -- Transform the original 'id' (aliased as commodity) with exceptions
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'lpg' THEN 'LPG'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'rapeseed oil' THEN 'Rapeseed'
        WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(id, '-', ' ')) = 'brent crude oil' THEN 'Brent'
        ELSE ARRAY_JOIN(
            TRANSFORM(
                SPLIT(REPLACE(id, '-', ' '), ' '),
                word -> UPPER(SUBSTRING(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(word, 2))
            ),
            ' '
        )
    END AS commodity
FROM
    shippingbi.construction_news_items_history
WHERE
    -- Added to prevent errors from rows with no date
    date IS NOT NULL AND date != ''
